The relationship with AP is ending September 2022.

Despite a national company with strong purchasing power for web search of 624 in Spring 2018 to the current course enrollment of 272 which is a 56% percent decrease from the peak. 2.

With decreasing numbers, the remaining tuition leaves a slim margin for program delivery and associated costs. 4.
Rhode Island is not a Compact License state.
